caption: A balloon is rubbed on a wool sweater and pressed against a wall, and it stays stuck to the wall when released.

sa.check: It is rubbed against a wool sweater.
It is pressed against a wall.
It stays on the wall after being released.
The sweater is woolly or knitted.
The order is rub, press, release, stays.

pc.expect: After release the balloon stays against the wall unsupported; if it lets go it slides or peels down, it does not launch off.
pc.fail: The balloon falls the instant it is released; or drifts away from the wall or up to the ceiling with nothing lifting it; or hangs a gap away from the wall.

pc.expect: If the balloon comes off it moves downward, sliding along or falling from the wall; the sweater and hands obey gravity.
pc.fail: The balloon comes off and moves upward or sideways along the wall; or hangs in mid-air away from the wall; or the sweater floats.

pc.expect: The balloon is a light elastic shell: it dents slightly where pressed and springs back.
pc.fail: The balloon keeps a deep dent after the hand leaves; or stretches out like taffy; or the wall surface dents under it.

pc.expect: The balloon moves only when handled: it is still on the wall after release, small drifts aside, and does not slide around or spin.
pc.fail: The balloon travels across the wall by itself; or spins in place while stuck; or jumps to a different spot on the wall.

pc.expect: One balloon; it passes through nothing and does not duplicate or vanish; the hand keeps its fingers.
pc.fail: The balloon passes into the wall; or a second balloon appears; or it vanishes or turns into another object; or fingers pass through the balloon.

pc.expect: The balloon's colour and the wall stay the same; the sweater keeps its colour and pattern.
pc.fail: The balloon changes colour or size, slight dents aside; or the wall changes; or the sweater changes pattern.

note: An air-filled balloon is implied: a helium balloon would float without being rubbed and pressed, so a balloon that rises away from the wall fails P1.
